{{StoryCite|story=No Good Deed...|book=Darth Vader (2017) 1|bformatted=''Darth Vader'' (2017) 1}} occurs after [[Anakin Skywalker]] became Darth Vader, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. The mini-comic also occurs before the events of ''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' which ''Timelines'' dates to [[14 BBY]] as by that time, Vader's [[flagship]] is the ''[[Perilous]]'', and not his [[Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class]] seen in this story. As such, the mini-comic must occur in or between these [[Standard year|years]].<noinclude>
